Sandbox_SuQingFreshnessFridge_Enabled_to: Disabling preserves the appliance, contents and per-fridge switches. Ordinary native refrigeration and aging apply.
Sandbox_SuQingFreshnessFridge_Capacity_t: 50–1000, default 200. Applies to new and loaded freshness fridges. Reducing capacity never deletes contents; native over-capacity insertion rules apply.
Sandbox_SuQingFreshnessFridge_RestoreHou: Game hours to restore one full fresh-life interval
Default 10, range 0.25–1000. Lower is faster. Uses each food's native fresh-life interval. Credit requires continuously observed loaded/powered time.
Sandbox_SuQingFreshnessFridge_AllowRotte: Gradually restores rotten food that still exists. Burning, poison, contamination, cooking and remaining portions are preserved. Fertilized eggs and foods without standard shelf-life thresholds are excluded.
